changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6c, item 1: workflow-service's protocol.ts is now the one IPC codec -- it gains normalizeAgentOptions, the parent-side isWorkflowRunnerChildMessage decoder (moved from runner-process.ts), and the child-side parseParentMessage decoder (moved from runner.ts). WorkflowSemaphore moves to a new semaphore.ts; WorkflowPersistenceError moves to errors.ts; MAX_AGENTS, MAX_HELPER_ITEMS, and MAX_SCRIPT_BYTES move into limits.ts unchanged. run-support.ts and agent-policy.ts are deleted: WORKFLOW_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT is inlined into run.ts (still exported), nonEmpty is inlined as a private run.ts helper, and every isRecord caller -- including runner.ts's own private errorMessage helper -- switches to dreamux-utils's isPlainObject, an identical typeof/Array.isArray check. Internal-only; no runtime or published-API change.
